colt.definition:
n. a young male horse under the age of four
n. a kind of revolver
colt.translation: n. 小马, 苔绳, 无经验的年轻人

colt distemper.translation: [医] 腺疫, 传染性卡他(幼马呼吸道传染病)

coltart.translation: [人名] [北方英格兰人、苏格兰人姓氏] 科尔塔特 Coulthard的变体

colter.definition: n. a sharp steel wedge that precedes the plow and cuts vertically through the soil

colting.definition:
-ing form of colt
n. a young male horse under the age of four
n. a kind of revolver
colting.translation: (colt 的现在分词) n. 小马, 苔绳, 无经验的年轻人

coltish.translation: a. 小马似的, 蹦蹦跳跳的, 不守纪律的

coltman.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 科尔特曼 Colt的变体

colts.definition:
n. a young male horse under the age of four
n. a kind of revolver
colts.translation: n. 小雄马( colt的复数形式 )

coltsfoot.definition: n. perennial herb with large rounded leaves resembling a colt's foot and yellow flowers appearing before the leaves do; native to Europe but now nearly cosmopolitan; used medicinally especially formerly
